feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: Xi said China would welcome American students for exchanges. What's the reality?
entry.summary: President Trump and China's leader Xi Jinping are due to meet in the Chinese city of Shenzhen. At their last summit in September, Xi said he will welcome 100,000 American students for exchanges.

entry.title: Many Alaska residents rely on oil for heat. This winter is set to be financially hard
entry.summary: In freezing Fairbanks, Alaska, where winter temperatures can dip below -40°F for a week or longer, most households use heating oil to stay warm in the winter. The Iran war is driving up costs.

entry.title: California sues OpenAI over AI agents hacking a software platform
entry.summary: The state of California is suing OpenAI over this summer's "rogue AI" incident, in which AI agents hacked into the Hugging Face website.

entry.title: Public health expert reacts to latest measles milestone
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with Dr. Ashish Jha, senior fellow at Harvard's Belfer Center and former White House coronavirus czar, about the news that the U.S. has lost its measles elimination status.

entry.title: NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft reaches a distance of 1 light-day from Earth
entry.summary: Early Wednesday morning, Voyager 1 will make history by reaching exactly one light day away from Earth.

entry.title: Nvidia tries to get back to business
entry.summary: Nvidia quarterly earnings are in. But the biggest question isn't about past business performance it's about the company's future leadership.

entry.title: U.S. officially loses its measles elimination status
entry.summary: The Pan American Health Organization announced that measles is no longer considered eliminated in the U.S. It's classified as endemic now because a strain has lingered in the U.S. for over a year.

entry.title: College grads turn to skilled trades
entry.summary: While the rise of AI continues to fuel the debate over whether college is worth the cost, apprenticeships in the skilled trades are having a moment, drawing in college graduates.

entry.title: Why an SNL comedy sketch about caretaking went viral
entry.summary: The SNL ad parody "Sister" hit home for daughters caring for parents without help from their brothers. NPR's Juana Summers speaks with writer Liz Plank about her Substack essay on why it resonated.

entry.title: Oldest Pearl Harbor survivor dies at 106
entry.summary: Freeman Johnson was below deck on the USS St. Louis when the Japanese attacked Pearl Harbor in 1941. He died this weekend at age 106.
